item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:00 HKT 24/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, it will be generally fine and persistently very hot over southern China today and tomorrow. Tropical Cyclone Doksuri will intensify progressively and move towards the Luzon Strait in the next couple of days. It may edge closer to the vicinity of the southern part of Taiwan afterwards. There is also a chance of moving towards the coast of eastern Guangdong. Its outer subsiding air will continue to bring very hot weather to southern China midweek this week. Showers and squally thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Unsettled weather associated with Doksuri is expected to affect the coast of southeastern China in the latter part of this week.
